page_title: GEN 2-3 ATA | Genoa v Atalanta 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+3' Mattia Bani (Genoa) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
90+3' Genoa force a corner. They send men into the box.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' 2 - 3 Goal! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and finishes with a low shot in off the right post. What a finish!
88' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
85' A pass into the box finds Morten Thorsby (Genoa) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Rui Patricio denies him.
83' Davide Ghersini blows for a foul after Marten de Roon (Atalanta) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
81' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ederson (Atalanta) replacing Ibrahim Sulemana.
80' Excellent touch by Jean Onana (Genoa)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
77' Andrea Pinamonti goes off the pitch and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) comes on.
77' It will be a substitution. Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is ready to enter the pitch as Vitinha walks off.
74' Here is a change. Marco Palestra is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
74' Substitution. Daniel Maldini did his best and is replaced by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marco Brescianini leaves the pitch and Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) comes on.
70' Isak Hien (Atalanta) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Davide Ghersini no option but to blow his whistle.
67' Patrick Vieira has decided to make a change. Jean Onana (Genoa) replaces Milan Badelj.
66' Substitution. Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) replaces Stefano Sabelli.
63' 2 - 2 Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and past the goalkeeper.
58' 2 - 1 Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
56' That will be all from Matteo Ruggeri who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta).
54' An accurate cross picks out Mattia Bani (Genoa) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
53' Aaron Martin (Genoa) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
51' Mattia Bani (Genoa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Davide Ghersini blows for a foul.
49' A short pass finds Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.

47' 1 - 1 What a goal! Ibrahim Sulemana (Atalanta) receives an accurate pass and tries his luck with a long-range shot. He unleashes a superb strike that goes into the bottom left corner and behind the goalkeeper.
46' The whistle blows and Davide Ghersini starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Genoa due to a handball in the build-up play.
45+1' Celebrations by Genoa are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Goal! Mattia Bani (Genoa) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 2:0.
44' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
41' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) makes a strong challenge and Davide Ghersini blows for a foul.
39' Dangerous play by Mateo Retegui (Atalanta). Davide Ghersini blows his whistle for a foul.
37' 1 - 0 Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) jumps for a cross and plants a brilliant header into the roof of the net.

36' OFF THE POST! Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the right post! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
35' Johan Vasquez just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Koni De Winter (Genoa) replaces him.

34' Golden chance! Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
31' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Nicola Leali has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
29' The free kick from long range, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' The corner is swung in but Genoa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
26' Vitinha (Genoa) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
24' Genoa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
22' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

22' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The ball is out of play. Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner.
21' Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

20' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Vitinha (Genoa). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. It will be a corner kick for Genoa.
18' Rough tackle by Isak Hien (Atalanta). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' A fine pass finds Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Nicola Leali reacts superbly to deny him.
13' Davide Ghersini couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) and blew his whistle.
11' A lofted pass finds Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar.
7' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.

6' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Rui Patricio pulls off a decent save to thwart him.

4' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) received a precise pass and hammers the ball at goal from close range. Unfortunately for him, his aim was a bit off and it flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.

2' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Genoa will have the kick-off.
Davide Ghersini will referee today's match.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
